title: Strong Block Node Investment Update - Its one month later, I'm 6 nodes in
description: Strongblock Nodes might be the craziest and most profitable passive income stream I have ever seen! I've had my nodes for one ...

asr.full_text: 5 weeks ago I invested in a strong block node. One day later I bought 2 more. Four days later I bought another one. Then 2 weeks later I bought one. And finally, a couple days ago, I just picked up my sixth, and for now, final node. My name is Nicholas Johnson, and this is the Space Warehouse. For a while there the price on the strong token was just going down and down and down, which is why I felt like I was getting a deal when I got in at like 400-something. At the same time though, if you were to look at the monthlong chart from October to November and year end, you wouldn't be faulted for thinking that this is a sinking ship. But towards the end of November, after testing $400 not once, not twice, but bouncing off of it 3 times, the tides began to turn on the strong trading chart. From the start of December until today, this is what we're seeing… I'll draw a trend line in there to make my point a little clear… So each node will cost you 10 STRONG, and the moment, each strong is valued at 610 US dollars, so to buy one node, youll be giving up $6,100 dollars. That money is then gone. It's not like a stock or a crypto, youre not investing in strong, youre purchasing a income stream and when yu have the node, and apparently for as long as you keep paying the $15 monthly maintenance fee, youll be paid back 0.1 strong per node per day. For me, that's $61 6 times a day or $366 dollars per day. 10980 dollars per month! Whatthefu- I made a video a little over a month ago about setting up these nodes and how to do it. A lot of the recent comments, I'm assuming because of the ever growing price of Strong, are asking me how it's going and what I think about the project in general. So far, I have to say this has been the single most lucrative crypto investment ive made yet. Buying a house but over the span of 10 years? Ive had these nodes in a month and im making the equivalent of a six figure salary. I guess thats where the concern creeps in. This is based in the fact that its basically set up the way a ponzi scheme was set up. Initial investors are paid dividends on their stake primarily out of the money from newer investors who buy in at a higher price or in bigger numbers. The reason this is good news is that the ponzi scheme is set up as trick and a lie to fool people into investing in it. In this case, the guys at StrongBlock do weekly public forums taking about how they plan to monetize their system and how they're taking on large and new partners constantly and that the burn tokens are going into a public wallet that anyone can look at anytime to confirm there isn't any f***ery going on. Now whether or not they're going to be successful monetizing this system, or whether they're able to find a way to draw out this payout schedule to a somewhat predictable end has yet to be seen. Right now you can't know if they will be successful and that's what makes this risky. They've talked about changing the payouts so they decrease slowly So if they did have enough money, the price would have dropped out of a couple of decades. And right now, you CANNOT know if they will be successful. And that's what makes this risky. They've talked about changing the payouts so they decrease slowly over time, so there is somehow equilibrium in the strong coming in vs the strong being paid out. AND they've been selling these very expensive NFTs to boost your income stream at the cost of boosting their strong stronghold. So I DEFINITELY cannot tell you if this is a safe place to put money at work if you want the highest number to go up. I can tell you that at that time as of now my money is working harder here than it was at my Bitcoin mining level, or my GPU mine investment... or my TV is moonshot although I know I'm right about that company just you wait. If I'm pressed to give my purely speculative opinion on the matter, I would say I'm betting it goes up as awareness grows for a good bit before exhausting the available pool of risk hungry crypto-prospectors. You could even call this a chart? Which I'm not gonna pick a number, but looking at charts on the daily it its on an uptrend,the one week is on an uptrend. The month long chart is a sharp uptrend. Looking back an entire year? Only on the 3 month range are we below the point were we started. But even then, clearly as the flight was heading hopelessly towards the water. Its unconscious pilot came too and was able to pull back on the stick to avoid the crash. Overall, I think its early. Do I have full confidence in this project? No, I do not. I am not affiliated with this company in any way, and I'm not sitting here today telling you that you should buy a strong block node or six. Do it. But I did, and if this week's trend continues into next week, I would have back the thirty-something thousand dollars I put into this thing in like another month. If you've been watching my channel for a good bit now, you may know that I don't do a very meticulous job of tracking the precise amounts I put into and take back out of these projects. Tax season is gonna be awesome. I honestly don't even ever calculate the amount of time it takes to pay back the money I invest. It's not alone. The money is gone! And this new income is now present. Also with strong, but with bitcoin too, the amount of this income changes daily. The period in which it will take to receive back the same amount of money income changes daily, and unexpectedly. So modeling the period of time it'll take to receive back the amount of money you put in is strictly impossible. As long as there's money falling out of the money tree, faster than this money made can sweep it up into her money dustpan, we're going to be just fine. Plus… as long as I spend the most of my money on new streams of income, no profit to be taxed on right? Is that how tax works? After 5 weeks, and after buying node after node. I at THIS MOMENT make $366 a day with strong block. 100% passive income. 99.99% passive income. My prediction is if prices keep going up, other node holders will start to cash out their sweet sweet strong bucks for americabucks which will cause the price to push back down. However if the price does push down that'll give the FOMO folks the reason they've been waiting for to finally buy-in which will bring the price back up. If you're on the fence and only if, fully losing this money, would not permanently impact your life every day you wait the risk is only growing until the day they announce a sustainable income for this token. And if that day does come well then today's strong price will most likely look like apple's stock price in the 1900's to our future node investor's. If the day never comes, then the market will likely spike at some unknowable point and fall off a cliff.
